scripts.build: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run build:playground && pnpm run build:docs && node scripts/assemble-site.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter "./packages/*" -r test && pnpm --filter @jpfun/playground test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter "./packages/*" -r typecheck && pnpm --filter @jpfun/playground exec tsc --noEmit
